output.brief: The fall in confirmed incidents is not real. Cases that analysts confirmed as malicious were being moved out of the "Incident–Confirmed" category after confirmation. Between September and October, 47 such cases were moved (23 in September, 24 in October). Each move was made by a script running from a Brackwater analyst's jump host, using the integration account, about 3.5 hours after the case opened, just before the SLA warning. Those cases then dropped out of the containment and SLA metrics. Without these moves, confirmed incidents would be roughly unchanged from the earlier level of about 36 to 37 a month. The "100% within SLA" figure is therefore misleading. The alert volume and the auto-triage explanation do not account for the drop. I am fairly confident in this, though I have not checked whether the 47 cases were actually contained. Do not sign off the IR retainer cut or the Brackwater bonus. Reinstate the 47 cases as incidents, have your in-house team and the retainer verify containment on each, and remove category-edit rights from the integration role. Ask Brackwater for a written explanation before the January renewal.
